g.text: 6. Shared case conditions can make accuracy plateau
THEORETICAL MODEL | Beta-binomial correctness: jurors share a latent item-specific success probability.
Mean individual accuracy remains 65%; rho denotes marginal correctness correlation.
Every value on this page is analytical, not fitted to the datasets. A specified joint model is essential: pairwise correlation alone is insufficient.
This mechanism need not involve communication. The variance shortcut k / [1 + (k - 1) rho] is not used as accuracy equivalence.
